## GET DIAGNOSTIC (QQ) PLOTS (Supplemental Figure 6)

```{r}

# Genomic inflation in EWAS
  ## Extract p_values for (M3/Health,SES,Behavior)
p_values9 <- demographic_rural$P.Value
p_values10 <- demographic_schlyrs$P.Value
p_values11 <- demographic_livegpar$P.Value
p_values12 <- demographic_chsmk$P.Value

  ## Extract lambda values (Model 3/Socioeconomic and behavior)
lambda_value9 <- calculate_lambda(p_values9)
lambda_value10 <- calculate_lambda(p_values10)
lambda_value11 <- calculate_lambda(p_values11)
lambda_value12 <- calculate_lambda(p_values12)


#Generate plots
  ## M3
qq_rural <- qq_plot2(p_values9, lambda_value9, "Grew up in a rural area")
qq_schlyrs <- qq_plotschlyrs(p_values10, lambda_value10, "Years in school")
qq_livegpar <- qq_plot2(p_values11, lambda_value11, "Live with a grandparent")
qq_chsmk <- qq_plotschlyrs(p_values12, lambda_value12, "Smoking during childhood")

# Combine
qq_plots3 <- plot_grid(qq_rural, qq_schlyrs,qq_livegpar, qq_chsmk, ncol = 2)

# Export
save_plot("Manuscript/Revisions/Oct122026_qq_plots_demographic.png", qq_plots3, base_width = 18, base_height = 15, dpi = 1200, bg = "white")

```

## VOLCANO PLOTS (Figure 3) 

### CHILD RURAL

```{r}

#Get Number with Higher and Lower Methylation
fdrp1 <- demographic_rural[demographic_rural$adj.P.Val < 0.05,]
sig1 <- demographic_rural$P.Value < 0.05
sig_between <- demographic_rural$P.Value < 0.05 & demographic_rural$P.Value >= 1e-7
betas_sig <- demographic_rural$logFCpercent[sig_between]
rural_higher <- sum(betas_sig>0, na.rm=T)
rural_lower <- sum(betas_sig<0, na.rm=T)
rural_total <- length(betas_sig)
pct_higher_sig <- (rural_higher/rural_total)*100
pct_lower_sig <- (rural_lower/rural_total)*100

cat("Higher Methylation N:", rural_higher, "(",round(pct_higher_sig, 2), "%)\n")
cat("Lower Methylation N:", rural_lower, "(",round(pct_lower_sig, 2), "%)\n")

 ## M1
#Plot
plot.volcano <- function(demographic_rural,main=NULL,xlim=NULL,ylim=NULL, nudge=0, title=""){par(mar=c(5,5,3,3))
#get betas and pvals from single sites results
betas <- demographic_rural$logFCpercent
pvals <- -log(demographic_rural$P.Value,10)
#assign colors
pcol <- ifelse(pvals < -log(0.05,10), 'darkslategrey', ifelse(betas>0,'#558899','#559999'))
#get percent hyper/hypo for sites above threshold
total <- table(pcol)['#558899'] + table(pcol)['#559999']
pct <- c(round(table(pcol)['#558899']/total * 100,1),round(table(pcol)['#559999']/total * 100,1))

#auto calculate axis range if not defined
if(is.null(xlim)){
  max.x <- max(abs(betas))
  xlim <- c(-max.x-0.05, max.x+0.05)
}
if(is.null(ylim)){
  ylim <- c(0,ifelse(max(pvals)<7, 7, max(pvals)+0.5))
}
df <- data.frame(betas=betas, pvals=pvals, col=pcol)
  ggplot(df, aes(x=betas, y=pvals, col=I(col))) +
    geom_point(size = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) + ggtitle(title) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log(0.05, 10),color='blue') +
    geom_hline(yintercept=7,color='red') +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "black") +
    annotate("segment", x = -0.12, xend = -0.9, y = max(ylim) - 0.2, yend = max(ylim) -0.2,
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.5, "cm")), color = "black", size = 0.5) +
    annotate("segment", x = 0.12, xend = 0.9, y = max(ylim) - 0.2, yend = max(ylim) -0.2,
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.5, "cm")), color = "black", size = 0.5) + 
    annotate("text", x = -1.0, y = max(ylim) -0.35, label = "Lower percent \n methylation", size = 6, hjust = 1.02) +
    annotate("text", x = 1.0, y = max(ylim) -0.35, label = "Higher percent \n methylation", size = 6, hjust = -0.02) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(title=element_text(size = 28), axis.text=element_text(size=25), axis.title = element_text(size = 28)) +
    xlab(paste0('Adjusted difference in percent DNA methylation')) + ylab(expression('-Log'[10]*'(P-Value)')) +
    annotate("text", x = xlim[2] - 0.02, y = 5.5, label = paste0(pct[1],'%'), color='darkslategrey', size = 10, fontface = 'bold', hjust = 1) +
    annotate("text", x = xlim[1] + 0.02, y = 5.5, label = paste0(pct[2],'%'), color='#558899', size = 10, fontface = 'bold', hjust = 0) 
}
volcano_rural3 <- plot.volcano(demographic_rural, ylim = c(0, 15.5), xlim = c(-6.5,6.5), nudge=0.015, title = "A. Grew up in a rural area")

```

### YEARS IN SCHOOL

```{r}

#Get Number with Higher and Lower Methylation
fdrp2 <- demographic_schlyrs[demographic_schlyrs$adj.P.Val < 0.05,]
sig2 <- demographic_schlyrs$P.Value < 0.05
sig_between <- demographic_schlyrs$P.Value < 0.05 & demographic_schlyrs$P.Value >= 1e-7
betas_sig <- demographic_schlyrs$logFCpercent[sig_between]
schlyrs_higher <- sum(betas_sig>0, na.rm=T)
schlyrs_lower <- sum(betas_sig<0, na.rm=T)
schlyrs_total <- length(betas_sig)
pct_higher_sig <- round(((schlyrs_higher/schlyrs_total)*100), digits = 1)
pct_lower_sig <- round(((schlyrs_lower/schlyrs_total)*100), digits = 1)

cat("Higher Methylation N:", schlyrs_higher, "(",round(pct_higher_sig, 2), "%)\n")
cat("Lower Methylation N:", schlyrs_lower, "(",round(pct_lower_sig, 2), "%)\n")


  ## M1
plot.volcano <- function(demographic_schlyrs,main=NULL,xlim=NULL,ylim=NULL, nudge=0,
              pct_higher_sig=NULL, pct_lower_sig=NULL, title=""){par(mar=c(5,5,3,3))
#get betas and pvals from single sites results
betas <- demographic_schlyrs$logFCpercent 
pvals <- -log10(demographic_schlyrs$P.Value)
#assign colors
pcol <- ifelse(pvals < -log(0.05,10), 'darkslategrey', ifelse(betas>0,'#558899','#559999'))
#get percent hyper/hypo for sites above threshold
total <- table(pcol)['#558899'] + table(pcol)['#559999']
pct <- c(round(table(pcol)['#558899']/total * 100,1),round(table(pcol)['#559999']/total * 100,1))

#truncate outlier values over 15 to plot to 15.5
pvals <- ifelse(pvals > 15, 15.5, pvals)

#auto calculate axis range if not defined
if(is.null(xlim)){
  max.x <- max(abs(betas))
  xlim <- c(-max.x-0.05, max.x+0.05)
}
if(is.null(ylim)){
  ylim <- c(0,ifelse(max(pvals)<7, 7, max(pvals)+0.5))
}
df <- data.frame(betas=betas, pvals=pvals, col=pcol)
  ggplot(df, aes(x=betas, y=pvals, col=I(col))) +
    geom_point(size = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) + ggtitle(title) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log(0.05, 10),color='blue') +
    geom_hline(yintercept=7,color='red') +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "black") +
    annotate("segment", x = -0.12, xend = -0.9, y = max(ylim) - 0.2, yend = max(ylim) -0.2,
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.5, "cm")), color = "black", size = 0.5) +
    annotate("segment", x = 0.12, xend = 0.9, y = max(ylim) - 0.2, yend = max(ylim) -0.2,
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.5, "cm")), color = "black", size = 0.5) + 
    annotate("text", x = -1.0, y = max(ylim) -0.35, label = "Lower percent \n methylation", size = 6, hjust = 1.02) +
    annotate("text", x = 1.0, y = max(ylim) -0.35, label = "Higher percent \n methylation", size = 6, hjust = -0.02) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(title=element_text(size = 28), axis.text=element_text(size=25), axis.title = element_text(size = 28)) +
    xlab(paste0('Adjusted difference in percent DNA methylation')) + ylab(expression('-Log'[10]*'(P-Value)')) +
    annotate("text", x = xlim[2] - 0.02, y = 5.5, label = paste0(pct_higher_sig,'%'), color='darkslategrey', size = 10, fontface = 'bold', hjust = 1) +
    annotate("text", x = xlim[1] + 0.02, y = 5.5, label = paste0(pct_lower_sig,'%'), color='#558899', size = 10, fontface = 'bold', hjust = 0) 
}
volcano_schlyrs3 <- plot.volcano(demographic_schlyrs, xlim = c(-6.5,6.5), nudge=0.015, title = "B. Years in school", pct_higher_sig = pct_higher_sig, pct_lower_sig = pct_lower_sig )

```

## OUTPUT RESULTS TO TABLE

### Demographic models

```{r}

cat("Top 20 significant CpG Sites for Association between Child Rural and DNAm: Adjusted for demographic covariates")
top_cpgs_demographic_rural <- demographic_rural %>% arrange(P.Value) %>% head(10)

cat("Top 20 significant CpG Sites for Association between Years of School and DNAm: Adjusted for demographic covariates")
top_cpgs_demographic_schlyrs <- demographic_schlyrs %>% arrange(P.Value) %>% head(10)

cat("Top 20 significant CpG Sites for Association between Live with a Grandparent and DNAm: Adjusted for demographic covariates")
top_cpgs_demographic_livegpar <- demographic_livegpar %>% arrange(P.Value) %>% head(10)

cat("Top 20 significant CpG Sites for Association between Child Smoking and DNAm: Adjusted for demographic covariates")
top_cpgs_demographic_chsmk <- demographic_chsmk %>% arrange(P.Value) %>% head(10)


#Set up individual exposure tables
top_cpgs_ruraltbl <-  top_tbl(top_cpgs_demographic_rural, "Top 20 significant CpG sites for Grew up in a rural area and DNAm: Adjusted for demographic covariates")
top_cpgs_schlyrstbl <- top_tbl(top_cpgs_demographic_schlyrs, "Top 20 significant CpG sites for Years in school and DNAm: Adjusted for demographic covariates")
top_cpgs_livegpartbl <- top_tbl(top_cpgs_demographic_livegpar, "Top 20 significant CpG sites for Live with a grandparent and DNAm: Adjusted for demographic covariates")
top_cpgs_chsmktbl <- top_tbl(top_cpgs_demographic_chsmk, "Top 20 significant CpG sites for Smoking during childhood and DNAm: Adjusted for demographic covariates")


gtsave(top_cpgs_ruraltbl, "Manuscript/Revisions/top_ruraltblOct122026.docx")
gtsave(top_cpgs_schlyrstbl, "Manuscript/Revisions/top_schlyrstblOct122026.docx")
gtsave(top_cpgs_livegpartbl, "Manuscript/Revisions/top_livegpartblOct122026.docx")
gtsave(top_cpgs_chsmktbl, "Manuscript/Revisions/top_chsmktblOct122026.docx")


#Get nominally significant sites (p<0.0001)
ruralsig_p0.0001 <- demographic_rural %>% filter(P.Value < 0.0001) #71
schlsig_p0.0001 <- demographic_schlyrs %>% filter(P.Value < 0.0001) #5363
livegparsig_p0.0001 <- demographic_livegpar %>% filter(P.Value < 0.0001) #18
chsmksig_p0.0001 <- demographic_chsmk %>% filter(P.Value < 0.0001) #507

all_exp_p0.0001 <- all_exposures %>% filter(P.Value < 0.0001) #4517 (rura=33; chsmk=361; livegpar=21; schlyrs=4102)
top_cpgs_by_exposure <- all_exp_p0.0001 %>% group_by(exposure) %>%
  arrange(P.Value, .by_group = TRUE) %>% slice_head(n = 20) %>% ungroup() 


#Save
sheets_p0.0001 = list('childrural' = ruralsig_p0.0001, 'SCHLYRS' = schlsig_p0.0001, 'LIVEGPAR' = livegparsig_p0.0001, 'CHSMOKE' = chsmksig_p0.0001)
write_xlsx(sheets_p0.0001, 'Manuscript/Revisions/Demographic Significant Sites P<0.0001.xlsx', format_headers = TRUE)

allexpsheets_p0.0001 = list('All exposures' = all_exp_p0.0001, 'By Exposure Top 20' = top_cpgs_by_exposure)
write_xlsx(allexpsheets_p0.0001, 'Manuscript/Revisions/Co-exposure Significant Sites P<0.0001.xlsx', format_headers = TRUE)

```
